title: Overconfidence and Calibration in Medical VQA: Empirical Findings and Hallucination-Aware Mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2604.02543v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in clinical decision support, more than accuracy is required: knowing when to trust their predictions is equally critical. Yet, a comprehensive and systematic investigation into the overconfidence of these models remains notably scarce in the medical domain. We address this gap through a comprehensive empirical study of confidence calibration in VLMs, spanning three model families (Qwen3-VL, InternVL3, LLaVA-NeXT), three model scales (2B--38B), and multiple confidence estimation prompting strategies, across three medical visual question answering (VQA) benchmarks. Our study yields three key findings: First, overconfidence persists across model families and is not resolved by scaling or prompting, such as chain-of-thought and verbalized confidence variants. translated_title: 医学视觉问答中的过度自信与校准：实证发现与幻觉感知的缓解方法
translated_abstract: 随着视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多地应用于临床决策支持，仅仅追求准确率已不足够：知道何时应该信任模型的预测同样至关重要。然而，在医学领域，针对这些模型过度自信问题的全面系统性研究仍然十分匮乏。我们通过一项关于VLM置信度校准的全面实证研究来填补这一空白，研究涵盖三个模型家族（Qwen3-VL、InternVL3、LLaVA-NeXT）、三种模型规模（2B–38B）、多种置信度估计提示策略，并在三个医学视觉问答（VQA）基准上进行。我们的研究得出三个关键发现：第一，过度自信在各个模型家族中普遍存在，且无法通过模型规模扩展或提示方法（如思维链和言语化置信度变体）来解决。第二，简单的后验校准方法（如Platt缩放）能够降低校准误差，并始终（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文对三个模型家族、多种规模的视觉语言模型在医学视觉问答任务上进行了系统性的置信度校准实证研究，发现过度自信问题普遍存在且无法通过模型扩展或提示策略解决，并提出了幻觉感知的校准缓解方法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a comprehensive empirical study of confidence calibration in medical VQA across three VLM families and multiple scales, finding that overconfidence persists regardless of scaling or prompting, and proposes a hallucination-aware mitigation approach.
